subject: Approval request: restore FTE for Infra Reliability (internal transfer & comp uplift)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: restore FTE for Infra Reliability (internal transfer & comp uplift)

Hi Laura / Neha —

Quick ask: Monica (cc'd) accepted an internal transfer to Platform Security effective Aug 23. That creates a hard vacancy on Infra Reliability (1.0 FTE). Given the current queue and the work to stabilize our cross-region failover project, I need approval to restore the headcount and publish a req for an external hire.

Key details:
- Role: Reliability Engineer (Infra) — individual contributor; team impact is immediate (failover rollout + oncall coverage).
- Timing: need offer out by end of August to onboard by late Sep.
- Compensation: market for this slug is ~10–15% above our current band midpoint. I'm proposing a one-time comp band uplift to the upper quartile for this req to remain competitive. Details in attached comp_band_proposal.pdf.
- Budget: owner is Platform Infrastructure (my org). I will absorb base salary within Q3 hiring plan if approved; asking for a temporary uplift to approved band for candidate attraction.

Attachments: headcount_worksheet.xlsx (shows current FTE plan), comp_band_proposal.pdf, org_chart_infra.png.

Can I get an OK from Neha for the band uplift and from Laura on headcount restore? If you want, I can route to Finance for budget code once you confirm.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Manager, Platform Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: restore FTE for Infra Reliability (internal transfer & comp uplift)

Thanks Rishi — can you: 
1) Summarize why we can't repool an open req from Platform Security or postpone non-essential work (I want to understand criticality).
2) Confirm the proposed band (exact salary range and target comp) and whether this is a permanent band change or a one-off authorized uplift for this hire.
3) Confirm which budget code you'll charge and whether there is headroom this quarter.

If the ask is purely timing-critical, note that finance approval will still be required for any uplift beyond the published band.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director of Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Katy Chen <katy.ch@talenthub.io>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: restore FTE for Infra Reliability (internal transfer & comp uplift)

Laura — thanks. Answers below and extra context for transparency.

1) Why not repool/postpone?
- Platform Security has already used their transfer slot for a headcount shift (they are over-allocated through Q4); they cannot release the slot without delaying two planned security initiatives with compliance dependencies.
- The failover rollout work is a blocker for a customer SLA milestone in Oct; delaying would push the milestone and require a short-term external contract for oncall coverage (estimated $20k).

2) Proposed band and nature of uplift:
- Current band for this IC level maps to "Reliability Engineer III" at band midpoint $155,000. Proposed offer band: $170,000–$185,000 (top quartile). That corresponds to a ~10–19% uplift vs midpoint.
- Request is for a one-off authorized uplift to the published band for this specific req (not a permanent band relevel). If approved, we'll document as an exception and close with hiring ops.

3) Budget / cost owner:
- Charge to budget code: INFRA-OPS-Q3 (I will reallocate savings from two deferred non-critical hires to offset the incremental cost this quarter). Spreadsheet attached (headcount_worksheet.xlsx) shows the reallocation (tab "Q3 swap").

Recruiter note: Katy from TalentHub has two screened candidates who match the profile and want offers ASAP. Katy is looped for speed if we get greenlight.

I can route to Finance for official approval once I have Neha's sign-off on the exception and Laura's headcount restore approval.

— Rishi

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Katy Chen <katy.ch@talenthub.io>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: restore FTE for Infra Reliability (internal transfer & comp uplift)

Thanks for the details, Rishi. I reviewed the comp_band_proposal and the headcount worksheet. I approve the one-off uplift to the offer band for this req on the following conditions: 

1) Finance receives the INFRA-OPS-Q3 reallocation note and signs off on the incremental cost before offers go out.
2) We document the uplift as a hiring exception (HR will file the EXC-6719 form).
3) Recruiter confirms final target comp within the approved $170k–$185k band and shares candidate shortlist with me before offer.

Katy — you may proceed with scheduling offers contingent on Finance sign-off. Monica — thank you for the heads-up and congrats on the move; please hand over runbook notes for the failover work by Aug 16.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
